labels.sickDays: Sick leave days in the year
labels.sickDaysHint: Total sick leave days taken in one year (maximum 182).
labels.normalTotal: Normal pay for the same days

notes.outside: {days} of these days go beyond the 182-day yearly limit, so they are not covered by the sick pay shown here.
notes.rules: Under Oman's Labour Law (Royal Decree 53/2023, Art. 82) sick leave is up to 182 days a year, paid at 100% of the wage for days 1–21, 75% for days 22–35, 50% for days 36–70 and 35% for days 71–182.
notes.disclaimer: Estimate only. The daily rate is the monthly gross wage divided by 30, and your contract may be more generous. Confirm with your employer or the Ministry of Labour.
